Buy Unlimited‑Section Website $7500

Yes. For $7,500 you get a full‑feature website with unlimited sections, galleries, admin panel, event spreadsheets, and email/form integrations. You pay a 50 % deposit, the rest at launch, and own the code, content, and domain outright.

How it works for a growing business

  1. Request the Signature website design service (/signature-website-design-service/).
  2. Provide your brand assets and a brief of the sections you need.
  3. Everbuilt Studio builds the site on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub – hosting is $0/month.
  4. You review the draft, request any tweaks, and approve the launch.
  5. After a week of development you receive the live site, plus 90 days of free care.

What you get and the cost

  • Unlimited sections and galleries, built to your specifications.
  • Built‑in admin panel for easy content updates.
  • Spreadsheet‑driven event listings, email and form integrations.
  • Custom design, SEO basics, and contact forms.
  • Ownership of all code, content, and the domain.
  • Launch price: $7,500 (50 % deposit, balance at launch).
  • Hosting: $0/month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.
  • 90 days free post‑launch care; optional care plans afterwards at $295/month or $595/month, cancel any time.

FAQ

Do I have to sign a long‑term contract? No. You pay the one‑time fee, own the site, and can cancel any optional care plan at any time.

What if I need changes after the 90‑day free care period? You can add a care plan for $295 or $595 per month, or request a one‑off update at the standard rate.

Will I be locked into a specific host? No. The site runs on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub, which have a $0/month hosting cost.

Ready to get your unlimited‑section website? Start the Signature package now
